run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways to tile an n by m floor with 1 by m tiles
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input pairs of n and m values
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming tiling algorithm that counts floor tiling combinations
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness across edge cases where n is less than or equal to m
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a preallocated list instead of repeated append calls
